messages:
maria: Heads up — small docs PR: dedicated provisioning checklist + terraform sample. Need reviews for SLA wording and eviction notes.
ton\: Link the PR?
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432
sean: quick skim: the provisioning checklist is good but we need to call out pre-alloc vs burst capacity differences under autoscale.
anya: also add a note about isolation: CPU/GPU tenancy != network isolation. Customers expect VPC-level separation.
maria: :thumbsup: added a section. pushed commit with terraform example.
maria: ```hcl
resource \"redwood_dedicated_pool\" \"prod\" {
  name = \"prod-gpu\"
  gpus = 8
  capacity_commit = 0.75
  region = \"us-west-2\"
}
```
tony: nit: change `capacity_commit` to `capacityCommitment` in API? our SDK uses `capacityCommitment` not snake_case.
maria: good catch — switching. also adding JS SDK snippet. can someone paste example?
sean: JS snippet: ```js
const pool = await Redwood.createDedicatedPool({
  gpus: 8,
  capacityCommitment: 0.75
});
```
anya: SLA phrasing: don't promise \"no evictions\" — say \"eviction events are rare; in overload cases we fall back to compatible model variants\".
maria: updated wording to \"eviction risk correlates with overcommit and priority tiers; see mitigation steps\".
infra-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/432 — visual check please
tony: Looks ok in preview. One more request: link to billing page re: reserved vs burst billing.
maria: added link and small migration note for customers moving from hosted to dedicated (keys, endpoint changes).
anya: We should add a quick migration checklist: update SDK client config, rotate keys, verify region, warm KV cache.
sean: Can we add a minimal Rollback paragraph for failed rollouts? Eg: how to switch route to previous model version.
maria: added rollback steps + CLI commands. example: `redwood rollout rollback --route prod -v 2026-02-22`
tony: LGTM. Approving now.
anya: :rocket: merging after CI passes.
maria: thanks all. will watch for any customer questions.
